description: A save when some audio could not be copied: the save happens, and the result lists the file in oldVersion.media and carries a warning line made by this server.

result.summary: opentune_save_project: saved the project to its file (path in path), replacing its previous content; a copy of the replaced content was kept in the oldversion folder next to that file (path in oldVersion.path); opening that copy with opentune_open_project goes back to it. The newest old version already held exactly this content, so no new copy was made. The audio of the replaced project could not be copied completely into the media folder inside the oldversion folder (listed in oldVersion.media.notCopied), so that old version may not find its audio when it is opened after the original audio files are gone. The project is no longer marked as changed. Not stored in the project file: which tracks are shown, the undo and redo history, global preferences. OpenTune also copies the audio the project uses into a folder next to the project file, named after it with _Media added.

lines.text: This change can be neither undone nor reverted by any request of the protocol.
The change is not saved in the project file.
Not undoable (OpenTune has no undo for this). No request of the protocol can restore the previous state.

The audio of the replaced project was not copied completely into the media folder inside the oldversion folder, so that old version may not find its audio when it is opened after the original audio files are gone (the files are in data.notCopied).
